thread:
Maya K: Heads up — small docs PR to rename a dashboard param across Console and tracing hooks. 'widgetParam' -> 'metricParam' (and we might actually prefer metricKey). Need quick sign-offs for SDK snippets, redirect, and a short note in cost/latency docs.
Samir: Thanks — can you paste the exact SDK snippet I should update for Node? Also which dashboard pages are impacted?
Maya K: Affected pages: Cost breakdown, Latency heatmap, and the dashboard quickstart. Snippet (old -> new):
```
// old
client.console.createWidget({ type: 'timeseries', params: { widgetParam: 'p99_latency' } })
// new
client.console.createWidget({ type: 'timeseries', params: { metricParam: 'p99_latency' } })
```
Also tracing hook header changed: use `x-rd-trace-id` instead of `x-rd-span`.
Leo: I'll take tracing hooks. Quick question — does the middleware example need to switch from `req.headers['x-rd-span']` to `req.headers['x-rd-trace-id']`?
Maya K: Yes, update middleware and the curl examples. Add a short note about backwards compatibility.
Priya: I can do the SDK snippet PR. I want to include both Node (async/await) and Python examples, plus a streaming example. Any preference on showing old->new mapping inline?
Maya K: :thumbsup: show both and a one-liner mapping table. Assigning @Priya to SDK, @Leo to tracing, @Samir for the Console pages. @docs-bot can you add a redirect from old anchors and run link checks?
docs-bot: Created task DOCS-4392, scheduled link-checker for 2024-10-12 03:00 UTC. Will post back if any broken anchors remain.
Samir: Also — the rename affects per-route cost attribution. I can add a sentence in Cost/Latency breakdowns explaining impact on unit reporting. Need a suggested blurb.
Maya K: Draft blurb: "metricParam (formerly widgetParam) is the canonical key used to surface metric time series across Console and SDKs. widgetParam will be supported for one release; please migrate your integrations. This change consolidates naming between tracing and dashboard telemetry."
Priya: I'll include that blurb and add both Node and Python snippets. Node sample will show: `await client.console.createWidget({...})` and a small streaming handler.
Leo: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/502 — includes tracing hook updates and middleware examples. Preview: https://deploy-preview-502--console-docs.redwood.com/dashboards
Samir: I'll review PR #502 this afternoon. Can we add a tiny e2e GIF showing p99 line change on the heatmap for the README? That helps reviewers.
Maya K: Good idea — add a 3-4s GIF, optimized. Thanks all, ping here when your PRs are ready and I'll coordinate the merge window (aiming for the Wednesday docs deploy).
